title: Full reviews of both shows coming soon :) #Broadway #NewMusical #Kris...
transcript: I feel like I accidentally booked a perfect double feature. I was just in Boston this past weekend seeing both Queen of Versailles and the new Gatsby musical. When I planned this trip, I was thinking of it more as like a theater barbenheimer with like the pink and glitzing glamour of Queen of Versailles mixed with like, the dark, Grady Gatsby. But honestly these two shows had way more in common than I was expecting them to like. Both of these shows explore the myth of the American Dream and also explore the ways in which the Uber wealthy and maintain their wealth by taking advantage of the lower working class universe. I was just a lot darker than I was expecting it to be. And while Jackie Segal is the protagonist, it definitely doesn't glorify her, and I actually thought it did a really good job at holding her accountable. And then of course you have Gatsby, which always has those classism undertones, but this production especially goes really hard on them. So yeah, if you're going to be in Boston, I definitely recommend checking out both of these shows. I kind of love that they're running at the same time, and it makes for a really good fuck the rich double feature.
classificationReason: Creator clearly attended both Queen of Versailles and Gatsby, sharing detailed opinions about themes, character treatment, and recommendations. Primary focus appears to be Queen of Versailles based on specific commentary.
